notablePrerequisites: Moritte of the Frost does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Moritte, adding {C}{C}.
Moritte dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it to the battlefield as a copy of River Kelpie with one +1/+1 counter on it.
Moritte enters the battlefield, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.
